definitions.definition_json: {"abstain_field":"abstain","description":"Primary activity at an explicit session or structural segment grain. The target ref declares the grain: session is session-level; phase/message/block are segment-level.","evidence_policy":"required","fields":[{"description":"Primary activity evidenced by the target.","enum_values":["debugging","design","implementation","research","writing","ideation","ops","procurement"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"activity","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Label confidence on the closed interval from zero to one.","enum_values":[],"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"name":"confidence","required":true,"value_type":"number"},{"description":"True when the available evidence does not support one primary activity.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"abstain","required":false,"value_type":"boolean"},{"description":"Concise evidence-grounded rationale for the label or abstention.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"rationale","required":false,"value_type":"string"}],"format":"polylogue.annotation-schema/v1","schema_id":"seed.activity","status":"active","target_ref_kinds":["session","phase","message","block"],"title":"Activity","version":1}

{"abstain_field":"abstain","description":"Actor-declared prospective goal events. This construct never infers abandonment or unresolved state; unresolved_inactive(H) belongs to the goal graph with a named horizon/frame/evaluation receipt.","evidence_policy":"required","fields":[{"description":"The prospective event actually declared by an actor.","enum_values":["opened","blocked","resumed","declared_resolved","superseded","explicitly_abandoned"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"event_type","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Stable goal/question graph identity addressed by the declaration.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"goal_ref","required":true,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Actor ref whose declaration the annotation records.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"declared_by_ref","required":true,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Authority mode; the seed admits declarations, not inferred lifecycle states.","enum_values":["actor_declared"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"declaration_authority","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Opening event ref for a close/block/resume/supersession declaration when known.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"opening_event_ref","required":false,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Replacement or related goal identity for a supersession declaration.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"related_goal_ref","required":false,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Confidence that the evidence contains the declared event.","enum_values":[],"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"name":"confidence","required":true,"value_type":"number"},{"description":"True when declaration evidence is insufficient.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"abstain","required":false,"value_type":"boolean"},{"description":"Concise evidence-grounded rationale for the label or abstention.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"rationale","required":false,"value_type":"string"}],"format":"polylogue.annotation-schema/v1","schema_id":"seed.goal-event","status":"active","target_ref_kinds":["message","block","work_event","observed-event"],"title":"Prospective goal event","version":1}

{"abstain_field":"abstain","description":"Observed outcome evidence, kept distinct from prospective goal events. Structural, rule-derived, and judged authority remain explicit provenance; historical backfill is marked rather than rewritten as prospective truth.","evidence_policy":"required","fields":[{"description":"Observed or explicitly unknown outcome evidence.","enum_values":["test_passed","commit_observed","deployment_observed","user_accepted","answer_declared","unknown"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"outcome_type","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Authority class under which the evidence is asserted.","enum_values":["structural","rule","judged"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"authority","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Named parser, rule, metric, judgment, or operator authority.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"authority_ref","required":true,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Whether this is contemporaneous evidence or an explicit historical backfill.","enum_values":["observed","historical_backfill"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"temporal_mode","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Evidence confidence on the closed interval from zero to one.","enum_values":[],"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"name":"confidence","required":true,"value_type":"number"},{"description":"True when available evidence cannot support an outcome classification.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"abstain","required":false,"value_type":"boolean"},{"description":"Concise evidence-grounded rationale for the label or abstention.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"rationale","required":false,"value_type":"string"}],"format":"polylogue.annotation-schema/v1","schema_id":"seed.outcome-evidence","status":"active","target_ref_kinds":["session","work_event","observed-event","commit","check-run","github-pr","delegation"],"title":"Outcome evidence","version":1}

{"abstain_field":"abstain","description":"Evidence-linked decisions, lessons, preferences, fact candidates/established facts under a named authority, and commitments.","evidence_policy":"required","fields":[{"description":"Knowledge artifact family.","enum_values":["decision","lesson","preference","fact_candidate","fact_established","commitment"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"artifact_type","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"The bounded proposition or commitment represented by the artifact.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"statement","required":true,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Authority class under which the artifact is proposed or established.","enum_values":["agent_candidate","actor_declared","structural","rule","operator_judged"],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"authority","required":true,"value_type":"enum"},{"description":"Named actor, parser, rule, or judgment authority.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"authority_ref","required":true,"value_type":"string"},{"description":"Artifact confidence on the closed interval from zero to one.","enum_values":[],"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"name":"confidence","required":true,"value_type":"number"},{"description":"True when evidence is insufficient to classify the artifact.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"abstain","required":false,"value_type":"boolean"},{"description":"Concise evidence-grounded rationale for the label or abstention.","enum_values":[],"maximum":null,"minimum":null,"name":"rationale","required":false,"value_type":"string"}],"format":"polylogue.annotation-schema/v1","schema_id":"seed.knowledge-artifact","status":"active","target_ref_kinds":["session","message","block","work_event","assertion"],"title":"Knowledge artifact","version":1}
